_key.description: Variant key, Ensembl gene ID and source file accession joined by underscores.

effect_size.description: Estimated fractional change in gene expression for the effect allele relative to the other allele. Positive values indicate increased expression, negative values indicate decreased expression, and 0 indicates no change.

log2FC.description: Estimated log2 fold-change in gene expression for the effect allele relative to the other allele. Positive values indicate increased expression, negative values indicate decreased expression, and 0 indicates no change.

neg_log10_pvalue.description: -log10 of the uncorrected nominal P-value for the variant's effect on the gene. Null for the CRISPR-Millipede base-editing files, which report a posterior inclusion probability instead.

neg_log10_pvalue_adj.description: -log10 of the P-value after correction for multiple testing, by the method the source file names. Null for the CRISPR-Millipede base-editing files, which report a posterior inclusion probability instead.

power.description: Power to detect an effect of the size observed, from 0 to 1. Null for the CRISPR-Millipede base-editing files, which report a posterior inclusion probability instead.

posterior_inclusion_probability.description: Posterior inclusion probability from CRISPR-Millipede fine-mapping. The probability that the variant is in the causal set for the gene expression phenotype. Values range from 0 to 1.

coefficient_stddev.description: Standard deviation of the CRISPR-Millipede beta coefficient estimate. Reflects uncertainty in the effect size estimate.

significant.description: Whether the variant-gene association is statistically significant. For Variant-EFFECTS, adjusted p-value < 0.05. For CRISPR-Millipede, posterior inclusion probability (PIP) > 0.1.

name.description: Predicate describing the relationship in the _from to _to direction; always 'modulates expression of' for these CRISPR variant-to-gene measurements.

inverse_name.description: Predicate describing the same relationship in the _to to _from direction; always 'expression modulated by'.

source.description: The dataset this measurement was loaded from; always IGVF for these CRISPR screens.

source_url.description: Link to the IGVF tabular file this measurement was read from, for example https://data.igvf.org/tabular-files/IGVFFI0332UGDD.

files_filesets.description: Handle of the files_filesets record for the file this measurement was read from.

method.description: Method for the variant to gene edge, from the associated files_filesets record

crispr_modality.description: The CRISPR modality from the associated files_filesets record

biological_context.description: Plain-language summary of the biosample the assay was run in, taken from the file's fileset metadata.

biosample_term.description: Ontology term for the biosample the assay was run in, taken from the file's fileset metadata.

treatments_term_ids.description: Ontology term identifiers for the treatments applied to the samples for the purpose of perturbation, taken from the file's fileset metadata. Null when none were applied.

accessible_via.return: effect_size, log2FC, neg_log10_pvalue, neg_log10_pvalue_adj, power, posterior_inclusion_probability, coefficient_stddev, significant, source, label, method, crispr_modality, class, source_url, files_filesets, biological_context, biosample_term
